title: Gavia Fondo 0 Tubeless Tyre
notes: Official UK store read 2026-11-01: £54.99; sizes 700x28c and 700x32c; 'Hookless compatible'. For winter training, mixed terrain and long rides in the wet; endurance tread pattern for better wet and mixed-terrain grip; RR-E dual compound (durable centre, tackier shoulder); 170 TPI; Race Shield. 700x28C 80-105 psi (5.5-7.2 bar), about 330 g; 700x32C 50-75 psi (3.5-5.1 bar), about 370 g.
